relationships.subject: Z944
relationships.evidence_quote: Application of 1 μM Z944 inhibited the T-type calcium current by 75.3 ± 3.5% (n = 8), while the HVA calcium current was inhibited by only 10.2 ± 3.4% (n = 14; Fig. 6H).

relationships.subject: ABT-639
relationships.evidence_quote: We also found that ABT-639, a previously described Cav3 inhibitor,21 did not inhibit the T-type calcium current in human DRG neurons (Fig. 6J)

relationships.subject: Nickel
relationships.evidence_quote: Application of nickel resulted in inhibition of the T-type calcium current by 80.8 ± 2.6% (n = 12), while the HVA calcium current was inhibited by only 14.0 ± 1.8% (n = 25; Fig. 6E).

relationships.subject: TrkB-positive human DRG neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Cav3.2 was widely expressed in 60% of TrkB-positive neurons (Fig. 3A and B)

relationships.subject: Nav1.8-positive human DRG neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Strikingly, most Cav3.2 mRNA-positive neurons (92%) did not express Nav1.8 mRNA (Fig. 1E and F)

key_findings: Cav3.2 mRNA and T-type current are found in ~20% of human DRG neurons, mostly TrkB-positive and largely Nav1.8/TRPV1-negative.
T-type current was inhibited by nickel and Z944 but not ABT-639, and was more prevalent in neurons from female donors despite equal Cav3.2 RNA.
